query:
UPDATE media SET
             "qualityProfileId" = CASE WHEN $2 THEN $3 ELSE "qualityProfileId" END,
             "languageProfileId" = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE "languageProfileId" END,
             monitored = COALESCE($6, monitored),
             "libraryId" = COALESCE($7, "libraryId"),
             "updatedAt" = now()
           WHERE id = ANY($1)
